name: Aker Fern 2
source:
As Mikołaj Fern I have been travelling and experiencing many adventures along the way. I was considered an antagonist by most of people from that era. Over five hundred years have passed until I came back to live as Dan Tern. As him I will lead a certain story that never reached its definitive end.
